How it works

A clear path
to your next skill.

Know what to expect before you enrol, and give yourself the space to practise.

01 / Choose with intention.

Browse the masterclasses and read the course details. If you are unsure where to begin, tell Gracy what you already know, which equipment you have and what you want to make.

02 / Confirm the details.

Ask about dates, session times, delivery format, resource access and materials. Confirm the current fee in your payment currency and the cancellation terms before you pay.

03 / Enrol securely.

Use the original Selar course links or ask Gracy for the academy’s payment instructions. Keep your receipt. We do not ask you to enter card details on this website.

04 / Join and make.

Follow your joining instructions, prepare the required materials and practise alongside the lessons. Ask questions and use the resources available for your class.
